name: Transitive Graph Queries
description: Query the knowledge graph transitively: find all entities reachable from X within N hops. Supports bidirectional traversal, predicate filtering, and path extraction.
purpose: Enable powerful graph-based discovery in the memory system — finding related information through transitive relationships, enabling inference and connection discovery that flat keyword search cannot provide.
acceptanceCriteria: Transitive query: given entity X and depth N, return all reachable entities
Bidirectional traversal: traverse outgoing and incoming predicates
Predicate filtering: restrict traversal to matching predicate types
Path extraction: return the path(s) taken from origin to each reachable entity
Performance: N <= 5 with reasonable latency on 10K triple graph
rollback_strategy: Disable transitive query cache; fall back to direct lookup
recovery_strategy: Rebuild graph traversal index from triple store
